visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black off-shoulder mini dress, is kneeling on a white fabric-covered sofa. She is aggressively punching and wrestling with a large red heart-shaped pillow in a brightly lit indoor living room setting with a beige curtain and some framed pictures in the background. (2) The scene transitions to the same woman wearing a red off-shoulder dress, standing against a colorful, animated background reminiscent of a control room from the movie 'Inside Out'. She displays a frustrated facial expression with her hands on her hips. (3) The woman appears in a blue off-shoulder dress with a side cutout. An overlay of a large kitchen knife prop appears to be stuck through her head horizontally. She is in front of a CGI-rendered volcanic landscape with flowing lava, gesturing while speaking to someone off-camera. (4) High-quality video game footage is shown, featuring supernatural and post-apocalyptic themes. Characters are seen in eerie environments with monsters and mechanical structures under dark, moody lighting. (5) The woman returns in her blue dress, now against a backdrop of monsters from the game. (6) The video concludes with a stylized 3D wooden figure with large eyes holding a bat, moving rhythmically in a dark outdoor scene at night.

It blends social media trend aesthetics with professional game marketing.
